AnnouncementDate.name: Announcement Date
AnnouncementDate.definition: Date/time at which the issuer announced that a corporate action event will occur.

CertificationDeadline.name: Certification Deadline
CertificationDeadline.definition: Deadline by which the certification must be sent.

CourtApprovalDate.name: Court Approval Date
CourtApprovalDate.definition: Date upon which the court provided approval.

EarlyClosingDate.name: Early Closing Date
EarlyClosingDate.definition: First possible early closing date of an offer if different from the expiry date.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date/time at which an event is officially effective from the issuer's perspective.

EqualisationDate.name: Equalisation Date
EqualisationDate.definition: Date/time on which all or part of any holding bought in a unit trust is subject to being treated as capital rather than income. This is normally one day after the previous distribution's ex date.

FurtherDetailedAnnouncementDate.name: Further Detailed Announcement Date
FurtherDetailedAnnouncementDate.definition: Date/time at which additional information on the event will be announced, for example, exchange ratio announcement date.

FixingDate.name: Fixing Date
FixingDate.definition: Date/time at which an index / rate / price / value will be determined.

LotteryDate.name: Lottery Date
LotteryDate.definition: Date/time on which the lottery is run and applied to the holder's positions. This is also applicable to partial calls.

NewMaturityDate.name: New Maturity Date
NewMaturityDate.definition: Date/time to which the maturity date of an interest bearing security is extended.

MeetingDate.name: Meeting Date
MeetingDate.definition: Date/time on which the bondholder's or shareholder's meeting will take place.

MarginFixingDate.name: Margin Fixing Date
MarginFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which the margin rate will be determined.

ProrationDate.name: Proration Date
ProrationDate.definition: Date/time (and time) at which an issuer will determine the proration amount/quantity of an offer.

RecordDate.name: Record Date
RecordDate.definition: Date/time at which positions are struck at the end of the day to note which parties will receive the relevant amount of entitlement, due to be distributed on payment date.

RegistrationDeadline.name: Registration Deadline
RegistrationDeadline.definition: Date/time on which instructions to register or registration details will be accepted.

ResultsPublicationDate.name: Results Publication Date
ResultsPublicationDate.definition: Date/time on which results are published, for example, results of an offer.

DeadlineToSplit.name: Deadline To Split
DeadlineToSplit.definition: Deadline by which instructions must be received to split securities, for example, of physical certificates.

DeadlineForTaxBreakdownInstruction.name: Deadline For Tax Breakdown Instruction
DeadlineForTaxBreakdownInstruction.definition: Date/time on until which tax breakdown instructions will be accepted.

TradingSuspendedDate.name: Trading Suspended Date
TradingSuspendedDate.definition: Date/time at which trading of a security is suspended as the result of an event.

UnconditionalDate.name: Unconditional Date
UnconditionalDate.definition: Date/time upon which the terms of the take-over become unconditional as to acceptances.

WhollyUnconditionalDate.name: Wholly Unconditional Date
WhollyUnconditionalDate.definition: Date/time at on which all conditions, including regulatory, legal etc. pertaining to the take-over, have been met.

ExDividendDate.name: Ex Dividend Date
ExDividendDate.definition: Date/time as from which trading (including exchange and OTC trading) occurs on the underlying security without the benefit.

OfficialAnnouncementPublicationDate.name: Official Announcement Publication Date
OfficialAnnouncementPublicationDate.definition: Date/time at which the corporate action is legally announced by an official body, for example, publication by a governmental administration.

SpecialExDate.name: Special Ex Date
SpecialExDate.definition: Date/time from which 'special processing' can start to be used by participants for that event. Special processing is a means of marking a transaction, that would normally be traded ex or cum, as being traded cum or ex respectively, for example, a transaction dealt 'special' after the ex date would result in the buyer being eligible for the entitlement. This is typically used in the UK and Irish markets.

GuaranteedParticipationDate.name: Guaranteed Participation Date
GuaranteedParticipationDate.definition: Last date/time by which a buying counterparty to a trade can be sure that it will have the right to participate in an event.

ElectionToCounterpartyMarketDeadline.name: Election To Counterparty Market Deadline
ElectionToCounterpartyMarketDeadline.definition: Deadline by which an entitled holder needs to advise their counterparty to a transaction of their election for a corporate action event, also known as Buyer Protection Deadline.

ElectionToCounterpartyResponseDeadline.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline
ElectionToCounterpartyResponseDeadline.definition: Date/time the account servicer has set as the deadline to respond, with instructions, prior to the election to counterparty market deadline.

LapsedDate.name: Lapsed Date
LapsedDate.definition: Date/time at which an event/offer is terminated or lapsed.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which the movement is due to take place (cash and/or securities).

ThirdPartyDeadline.name: Third Party Deadline
ThirdPartyDeadline.definition: Date/time by which the account owner must instruct directly another party, for example, to provide documentation to an issuer agent.

EarlyThirdPartyDeadline.name: Early Third Party Deadline
EarlyThirdPartyDeadline.definition: Date/Time set by the issuer agent as a first early deadline by which the account owner must instruct directly another party, possibly giving the holder eligibility to incentives. For example, to provide documentation to an issuer agent.

MarketClaimTrackingEndDate.name: Market Claim Tracking End Date
MarketClaimTrackingEndDate.definition: Date by which the depository stops monitoring activities of the event, for instance, accounting and tracking activities for due bills end.

LeadPlaintiffDeadline.name: Lead Plaintiff Deadline
LeadPlaintiffDeadline.definition: Last day an investor can become a lead plaintiff.

FilingDate.name: Filing Date
FilingDate.definition: Date on which the action was filed at the applicable court.

HearingDate.name: Hearing Date
HearingDate.definition: Date for the hearing between the plaintiff and defendant, as set by the court.

EffectiveDateRule.definition: Effective date is to be used in events where there is no concept of entitlement, for example Name Change (CHAN) or Place of Incorporation (PLAC), and in events where there is a sense of eligibility but with a legal obligation, for example Merger (MRGR).
